## How to use
Start from `playbook/PLAYBOOK.index.yaml`.
- Match `editRoutes.when` to the change.
- Follow `action` if present.
- Read every file in `open`, then `thenRead`.
- If a route has `mustHold`, those lines are hard contracts. Do not skip them.
